summary.business_type: Entertainment web application / satirical shopping simulator
top_findings: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, and AI discovery paths return the SPA HTML with 200 text/html
Primary content is client-rendered and thin in the initial HTML
Production canonical and OG URLs must replace localhost
Initial JavaScript bundle is 572.46 kB minified
quick_wins: Add production origin metadata at deployment
Add a crawlable explanation of the simulator

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Title, description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter metadata, and viewport are present

findings.title: Invalid discovery endpoints
findings.description: /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /llms.txt, and /.well-known/ai-plugin.json return 200 text/html containing the app shell.
findings.recommendation: Serve real files with correct content types and validate them in production.

findings.title: Soft-404 unknown paths
findings.description: /nonexistent-seo-check returns 200 text/html and the SPA shell.
findings.recommendation: Return a real 404 for unknown paths while preserving client routing only for known app routes.

findings.title: Client-rendered primary content
findings.description: The raw document contains an empty root plus noscript fallback; core catalog content is rendered by React.
findings.recommendation: Use SSR, SSG, or a richer static fallback for the homepage and public content.

findings.title: Localhost metadata
findings.description: Static canonical and og:url currently point to http://localhost:3001/.
findings.recommendation: Inject the production origin during deployment.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: No CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy was observed on the local response.
findings.recommendation: Set security headers at the production server or hosting layer.

findings.title: Limited explanatory content
findings.description: Rendered homepage contains about 424 words, but the core explanation is brief and mostly UI labels.
findings.recommendation: Add crawlable copy explaining what the simulator is, how fantasy pricing works, and that no real products are sold.

findings.title: Weak trust and freshness signals
findings.description: No owner/about details, update date, contact link, or catalog freshness signal is visible.
findings.recommendation: Add lightweight About, Privacy, Contact, and Last updated information.

findings.title: Moderate AI citability
findings.description: The concept is clear, but there are few self-contained factual passages outside interactive controls.
findings.recommendation: Add concise answer-style paragraphs for simulator, pricing, sharing, and fictional-product questions.

findings.title: State-dependent route content
findings.description: The single / URL can render Play, Cart, Worlds, Game, receipt, and remix states without distinct crawlable URLs.
findings.recommendation: Use route-level URLs for public experiences or mark stateful query variants noindex with intentional canonicals.

findings.title: No external authority links
findings.description: No external links were rendered on the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Add authoritative links only where they clarify privacy, fictional commerce, or product provenance; avoid forced links.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Zero-price Offer accurately describes the simulator

findings.title: Schema URL is missing
findings.description: WebApplication JSON-LD has no url property and the static URL is localhost.
findings.recommendation: Add the absolute production URL, image or screenshot, and a real provider only if one exists.

findings.title: Do not mark fictional items as products
findings.description: The catalog is entertainment content rather than real purchasable inventory.
findings.recommendation: Keep WebApplication schema and avoid Product markup for fictional items.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: Images reserve layout space in ProductCard
Below-fold product images use lazy loading
No obvious hero image LCP blocker

findings.title: Large initial JavaScript chunk
findings.description: Production build emits a 572.46 kB minified JavaScript chunk, 154.01 kB gzip.
findings.recommendation: Lazy-load Worlds, Cart, Game, remix, modal, and challenge modules with route/component splitting.

findings.title: Font and third-party loading risk
findings.description: Two variable Google font families are loaded from an external stylesheet.
findings.recommendation: Self-host or subset fonts, use font-display, and preload only the critical face.

findings.title: CWV unavailable locally
findings.description: LCP, INP, and CLS could not be measured against localhost or CrUX.
findings.recommendation: Measure a production deployment with Lighthouse and real-user field data.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Rendered product images have descriptive alt text
Stable fixed media containers are present

findings.title: Remote image dependency
findings.description: Product imagery is served from Googleusercontent and Unsplash URLs.
findings.recommendation: Host optimized WebP/AVIF derivatives locally or through a controlled image CDN.

findings.title: Image dimensions vary by state
findings.description: The Play product cards include dimensions in source, but the persisted Cart view rendered images without width/height attributes.
findings.recommendation: Apply width, height, and sizes consistently to every image component.

findings.title: No usable llms.txt or agent discovery file
findings.description: The requested endpoints return the SPA shell instead of Markdown or JSON.
findings.recommendation: Serve valid optional discovery files and an explicit crawler policy if they are part of the publishing strategy.

findings.title: Low raw citability
findings.description: Non-JavaScript agents receive almost no product or feature content.
findings.recommendation: Prerender the core explanation, representative catalog, and feature descriptions.

findings.title: No external brand signals
findings.description: No sameAs, organization identity, author, citations, or public authority signals were found.
findings.recommendation: Add verifiable brand identity and appropriate public profiles over time.

categories.name: Search Experience
what_works: Strong tool/page-type fit for fake shopping simulator intent
Cart, surprise, challenge, and sharing workflows

findings.title: Expectation mismatch for real shopping queries
findings.description: Luxury product names and prices resemble commerce content, but nothing is actually sold.
findings.recommendation: State prominently in crawlable copy that this is a fictional simulator with no purchases.

findings.title: Social loop is under-explained
findings.description: Challenge and remix behavior is available but not fully explained in indexable content.
findings.recommendation: Add a short section describing cart sharing and friend challenges.

categories.name: Visual / Accessibility
what_works: Desktop and mobile layouts render cleanly

findings.title: Mobile safe-area polish
findings.description: Fixed bottom navigation sits at the viewport edge on physical iOS devices.
findings.recommendation: Add env(safe-area-inset-bottom) padding to the bottom navigation.

findings.title: Audit limitation
findings.description: Modal focus trapping and escape behavior were not fully verified by the local browser audit.
findings.recommendation: Add automated keyboard and focus tests for modal workflows.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Replace localhost metadata with deployment origin

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add crawlable simulator explanation and trust copy
Normalize image dimensions across all views

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add About, Privacy, Contact, and update signals
Add real organization and sameAs data if applicable

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Run production Lighthouse and CrUX checks
Validate schema and discovery files after deployment
Monitor soft-404s, index coverage, and bundle size

tooling_limitations: render_page.py produced no usable Windows JSON output
CrUX and live SERP data unavailable for localhost
